monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral monitor specification, placement, acceptance-test, failure-path, and first-year-cost worksheet with a buy-nothing option; it contains no merchant, model, price, coupon, stock, ranking, review, or paid placement.

image_qa.note: Both new assets use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, clinical, grow-room, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed, so there is no ambiguous product depiction.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.274% CTR, and average position 19.199. No unaddressed page or query had a sufficiently supported position-4-to-20 opportunity, so no item is primarily Data-led. The Guides hub signal (three impressions, one click, position 7.3) was acted on October 26; Stem Cell CBG (19 impressions, one click, position 6.0) was materially reinforced October 15 and October 24. About and Contact were treated as navigational, Montana and one-impression rows as too small, and Blue Dream positions around 48–70 as outside the target band. Today's work therefore expands distinct evergreen authority and technical trust without inventing an analytics mandate.

authority.action: Published a clinician-conversation toolkit grounded in NCCIH, FDA, and AHRQ primary guidance, including a product record, whole-medicine reconciliation, timeline, question set, urgent lane, and one-page handoff. It is reciprocally linked with medication-interaction, surgery, and older-adult safety pages. Article citations across the site are now generated from visible official-source panels and audited for exact parity. No outreach was sent and no speculative outreach target was logged.
